description: A date on the show's model (go_on_date) is written in the background, usually in 1 to 5 minutes. This waits (up to 50 seconds) until it's ready and returns it like get_episode; if it's still being written, call it again. Use it instead of polling.

since_turn.description: Only the transcript from this line on (0-based; transcript_total says how many there are), for polling a date being written.

name: wait_for_episode
title: Wait for a date to be ready
